title: Anne Frank House

orientationControl.basis: Three-bay number 263 between neighboring 261 and 265. Generalized whole-envelope scale is retained; front/link/annex subdivisions remain photographic estimates reconciled against public-domain exterior originals. Neighboring rear feature 35184638705211 is excluded.

notes: The 5.88 by 24.1 m generalized envelope covers the front house and annex. Photo-derived partition: front z=3.3..16.7, connecting section z=-0.1..3.3, annex z=-7.4..-0.1. The rear roof ridge is transverse to the front-house ridge. These partitions are interpretive, not cadastral or measured. Modern museum and adjoining houses excluded.
limitations: Map is generalized at zoom 15; partition, windows and heights are visual estimates.

supplementalReferences.role: Complete three-bay canal elevation, cornice and hoist before restoration. Broken glazing and historical temporary closure are not reproduced.
Restored three-bay facade, black ground-floor frontage, cream upper window joinery, cornice and hoist.
Annex rear: three paired window rows, transverse tiled roof, central dormer and end chimneys. Modern alterations are not surveyed.

Court-facing wall with one lower and two upper windows, cream joinery, side-link windows and upper privacy louvers. Orientation is interpreted with the whole mapped envelope; no survey dimensions claimed.
Narrow light court, one central lower opening, side-link windows and low pitched glazed roof.
Solid black double entrance door at number 263, four-pane transom, raised panels and brass hardware.
